messages.content:
Start from the frozen canonical task and Base-only family domain. Choose and submit useful research actions autonomously using the available typed tools. Routing selects a tool; submit research_plan to perform a Plan. Use English for all new decisions and scientific interpretations. Read exact feedback and distinguish local mathematical diagnostics from independent task evaluation. Historical guidance grants no current evidence or permission. Stop and select the first complete independently accepted result after the required full read; otherwise stop truthfully within the original budget. No NMPC, PPO, automatic retries or extra success confirmations.
Write all research decisions and tool arguments directly in English. Scientific records and reports must originate in English.

content.text: Research Session prepared and identity-bound to the saved handoff preparation. No prior conversation copied. The next model request supplies the authoritative current state in CURRENT_RESEARCH_PACKET. Full history and original scientific evidence remain queryable from Store. Study: p4-m5-none-20261029-a01
Use actual saved evidence, choose your next research action or STOP, then consume feedback and decide freely.

function.description: Choose an available research action with a typed decision and evidence. A diagnose selected_method records intent; it does not execute analysis. After choosing a registered method and candidate, use research_analysis when offered and obtain exact method details through evidence_read. Only independent evaluation establishes acceptance. SELECT requires the Main Agent to read the full fresh passing result. For STOP, retrieve and cite the complete new result index.
function.name: research_plan

claimed_inference.description: Use empirical_search for a proposed experiment, including testing a prediction in physics. Unsupported stronger claims remain annotated hypotheses and do not veto an otherwise legal experiment. Formal conclusions and SELECT/CONFIRM/STOP still require registered scoped evidence; execution always requires valid identity, authorization, applicability and budget.
claimed_inference.title: Claimed Inference

requested_budget.description: Declared request cap, not actual cost or authorization. For Plan control_search match settings.evaluation_requests (physical replay callbacks); otherwise declared operation units. Zero independent physical evaluations does not imply zero Native integration. Missing formal scope and unknown costs remain unresolved until normal admission.
requested_budget.title: Requested Budget

selected_candidate.description: Required for execute/initialize_control/control_search/physical_replay. Match candidate, control_seed.candidate, control_search.candidate or physical_replay.candidate respectively; never substitute the control source.

selected_method.description: Intent label only; does not dispatch a worker or grant permission. Plan action and its payload determine execution. Native mathematical methods require research_analysis with the registered request_template. diagnose without diagnostic only reads existing evidence.
selected_method.title: Selected Method

angular_offsets_rad.description: Extra offsets: theta_j = phase_rad + 2*pi*j/count + angular_offsets_rad[j]. Empty uses equal spacing. These are not absolute angles.
angular_offsets_rad.title: Angular Offsets Rad

parameters.description: Submit the selected generate action. All original Plan validation and evidence admission apply. hypothesis is required; probe completion is not scientific STOP.

experience_disposition.description: Only actual experience_retrieve read receipt IDs or exact entry_id@revision keys. Omit when experience retrieval is unavailable; scientific artifact IDs and hypothesis names are not experience keys.
experience_disposition.title: Experience Disposition

parameters.title: Plan

function.description: Read a named missing fact or verify a relevant change using exact evidence and JSON pointer. Exact repeats add no information; delegate interpretation to research_investigate.
function.name: evidence_read

fields.description: Immediate child keys at an object pointer, not dotted paths. Use with view=fields for raw JSON, or with view=working_set/mathematical_capabilities to select fields inside that derived view. For a working_set list select a row by /control_result_links/<index> first; do not switch to raw view=fields for derived paths.
fields.title: Fields

pointer.description: Absolute JSON Pointer; use summary to discover child keys. Permanent Store references survive session handoff; temporary SDK offload references do not.
pointer.title: Pointer

function.description: Select a tool and action; load its Schema on the next request. No scientific execution or evidence credit.
function.name: research_route

parameters.description: Choose one tool and its Plan action or RL operation from tool_directory. Selection performs no scientific execution. The loaded tool can be reused; call research_route to switch.

action.description: Exact Plan action or RL operation from the directory; omit for other tools.
action.title: Action
